claims.quote: `schema/includes?` decides inclusion across all value kinds (`value/number?`, `value/integer?`, `value/string?`, `value/array?`, `value/object?`, `value/function?`, `value/symbol?`, `value/promise?`, `value/unknown?`, `value/undefined?`, `value/any?`), open records and lists (`schema/open` without rest), and unbounded collections (`schema/arrayOf` without `most`, `schema/recordOf`), e.g. `["schema/includes?", "value/number?", "value/integer?"]` gives `false` and `["schema/includes?", "value/string?", "value/number?"]` gives `false`.

`schema/includes?` gives `false` for `value/number?` in `value/integer?`, `value/string?` in `value/number?`, and open records in exact records, and `true` when an unbounded `schema/arrayOf` is covered by a `schema/anyOf` of empty and open lists.
